class.name: Steam
class.brief_description: Steamworks integration: authentication tickets, achievements and stats, inventory, and Steam Workshop.

method.name: add_item_key_value_tag
method.description: Adds a key-value tag to the item in an update. A key can have several values. Keys and values are limited to 255 characters.

method.name: add_item_preview_file
method.description: Adds an additional preview file (image, environment map, ...) to the item in an update. [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] paths are converted to absolute paths.

method.name: add_item_preview_video
method.description: Adds a YouTube video (by video ID) as an additional preview to the item in an update.

method.name: add_item_to_favorites
method.description: Adds a Workshop item to the local user's favorites. Emits [signal workshop_favorites_changed].

method.name: add_lobby_list_distance_filter
method.description: Sets how far away (by Steam region) listed lobbies may be. The default is [constant LOBBY_DISTANCE_FILTER_DEFAULT]. Applies to the next [method request_lobby_list] call only.

method.name: add_lobby_list_numerical_filter
method.description: Only list lobbies whose lobby data [param key], read as an integer, compares to [param value] as [param comparison] says. Applies to the next [method request_lobby_list] call only.

method.name: add_lobby_list_result_count_filter
method.description: Limits how many lobbies the next [method request_lobby_list] call returns. Fewer results are faster.

method.name: add_lobby_list_slots_available_filter
method.description: Only list lobbies with at least [param slots_available] open slots. Applies to the next [method request_lobby_list] call only.

method.name: add_lobby_list_string_filter
method.description: Only list lobbies whose lobby data [param key] compares to [param value] as [param comparison] says. Applies to the next [method request_lobby_list] call only.

method.name: authenticate_with_server
method.description: POSTs the hex-encoded session ticket to the auth server and returns the parsed response.

method.name: cancel_auth_ticket
method.description: Cancels a previously issued auth ticket handle.

method.name: clear_achievement
method.description: Clears an achievement for the local user in memory. Call [method store_stats] to persist.

method.name: clear_debug_log
method.description: Clears the in-memory debug log buffer.

method.name: clear_stat
method.description: Sets a numeric stat to [code]0[/code] in memory. Call [method store_stats] to persist.

method.name: create_lobby
method.description:
Creates a lobby of the given [param type] with room for [param max_members] players (1 to 250), and makes the local user its owner. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request couldn't be sent. The result arrives through [signal lobby_created]. On success, [signal lobby_joined] is emitted right after it, since the creator is already a member. [codeblock] func host_game(): Steam.lobby_created.connect(_on_lobby_created, CONNECT_ONE_SHOT) Steam.create_lobby(Steam.LOBBY_TYPE_FRIENDS_ONLY, 4)
func _on_lobby_created(result: int, lobby_id: int): if result != 1: # k_EResultOK return Steam.set_lobby_data(lobby_id, "name", Steam.get_persona_name()) var peer := SteamMultiplayerPeer.new() peer.create_host() multiplayer.multiplayer_peer = peer [/codeblock]

method.name: create_workshop_item
method.description: Creates a new, empty Workshop item owned by the local user. Emits [signal workshop_item_created] with the new published file ID, which can then be filled in with [method start_item_update]. Requires the app ID, either passed to [method initialize] or provided by the Steam client. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request could not be sent.

method.name: delete_lobby_data
method.description: Removes the lobby data [param key] from the lobby [param lobby_id]. Only the owner can do this.

method.name: delete_workshop_item
method.description: Permanently deletes a Workshop item owned by the local user. Emits [signal workshop_item_deleted]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request could not be sent.

method.name: download_item
method.description: Starts downloading or updating a Workshop item. If [param high_priority] is [code]true[/code], the item is moved to the front of the download queue and other downloads are suspended until it completes. [signal workshop_item_downloaded] is emitted when the download finishes. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request could not be made.

method.name: download_leaderboard_entries
method.description: Downloads entries from the leaderboard [param handle] and blocks until Steam answers (up to 10 seconds). Returns an empty array on failure. - [constant LEADERBOARD_GLOBAL]: ranks [param range_start] to [param range_end], starting at [code]1[/code]. - [constant LEADERBOARD_GLOBAL_AROUND_USER]: entries relative to the local user; for example [code]-4, 5[/code] returns 4 entries above the user, the user, and 5 below. - [constant LEADERBOARD_FRIENDS]: all of the local user's friends; the range is ignored.

method.name: download_leaderboard_entries_for_users
method.description: Downloads the entries of specific users (by Steam ID) from the leaderboard [param handle] and blocks until Steam answers (up to 10 seconds). At most 100 users can be requested at once. Users without an entry are left out.

method.name: find_leaderboard
method.description: Looks up a leaderboard by its API name and returns its handle, or [code]0[/code] if it doesn't exist or the request timed out. Blocks until Steam answers (up to 10 seconds). If [param create] is [code]true[/code], the leaderboard is created when missing, using [param sort] and [param display]. Leaderboards can also be created on the Steamworks partner site, in which case [param sort] and [param display] are ignored. [codeblock] var board := Steam.find_leaderboard("track_1_time", true, Steam.LEADERBOARD_SORT_ASCENDING, Steam.LEADERBOARD_DISPLAY_TIME_MILLISECONDS) [/codeblock]

method.name: get_achievement
method.description: Returns whether the local user has unlocked the named achievement.

method.name: get_achievement_info
method.description: Returns metadata and optional icon for a single achievement.

method.name: get_all_achievements
method.description: Returns an array of [SteamAchievementInfo] for every achievement defined for the app.

method.name: get_all_lobby_data
method.description: Returns all lobby data of the lobby [param lobby_id] as a [Dictionary] of [String] keys and values.

method.name: get_avatar_image
method.description: Returns the user's avatar as an RGBA [Image]. [param steam_id] [code]0[/code] uses the local user.

method.name: get_debug_log
method.description: Returns recent debug log lines when debug logging is enabled.

method.name: get_eligible_promo_item_definition_ids
method.description: Returns item definition IDs for promo items the user can still receive. [param steam_id] [code]0[/code] uses the local user.

method.name: get_friend_persona_name
method.description: Returns the Steam display name of [param steam_id]. Works for friends and for users the local user shares a lobby with; may return an empty string or [code][unknown][/code] for other users.

method.name: get_inventory_result_items
method.description: Parses [SteamInventoryItem] entries from a valid inventory result handle (before [method serialize_inventory_result] or destroy).

method.name: get_inventory_result_status
method.description: Returns the Steam result code for an inventory result handle ([code]k_EResult[/code] values).

method.name: get_item_download_info
method.description: Returns download progress for a Workshop item that is downloading: [code]bytes_downloaded[/code], [code]bytes_total[/code] and [code]progress[/code] (from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]). Returns an empty [Dictionary] if no download information is available.

method.name: get_item_install_info
method.description: Returns install information for an installed Workshop item: [code]size_on_disk[/code] (bytes), [code]folder[/code] (absolute path to the item's content) and [code]timestamp[/code] (Unix time of the installed version). Returns an empty [Dictionary] if the item is not installed.

method.name: get_item_state
method.description: Returns the local state of a Workshop item as a combination of [enum WorkshopItemState] flags, for example [code]WORKSHOP_ITEM_STATE_SUBSCRIBED | WORKSHOP_ITEM_STATE_INSTALLED[/code].

method.name: get_item_update_progress
method.description: Returns the progress of a submitted update: [code]status[/code] (a [enum WorkshopUpdateStatus] value), [code]bytes_processed[/code], [code]bytes_total[/code] and [code]progress[/code] (from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]).

method.name: get_launch_lobby_id
method.description: Returns the lobby ID passed on the command line with [code]+connect_lobby[/code], or [code]0[/code]. Steam starts the game this way when the player accepts a lobby invite while the game isn't running; call [method join_lobby] with the returned ID after [method initialize].

method.name: get_leaderboard_display_type
method.description: Returns how the leaderboard with handle [param handle] displays scores, or [constant LEADERBOARD_DISPLAY_NONE] if the handle is invalid or leaderboards are unavailable.

method.name: get_leaderboard_entry_count
method.description: Returns the total number of entries on the leaderboard with handle [param handle], or [code]0[/code] if the handle is invalid or leaderboards are unavailable.

method.name: get_leaderboard_name
method.description: Returns the API name of the leaderboard with handle [param handle], or an empty [String] if the handle is invalid or leaderboards are unavailable.

method.name: get_leaderboard_sort_method
method.description: Returns how the leaderboard with handle [param handle] is sorted, or [constant LEADERBOARD_SORT_NONE] if the handle is invalid or leaderboards are unavailable.

method.name: get_lobby_data
method.description: Returns the lobby data value for [param key] of the lobby [param lobby_id], or an empty string if it isn't set.

method.name: get_lobby_member_data
method.description: Returns the value of [param key] that the member [param steam_id] set with [method set_lobby_member_data], or an empty string.

method.name: get_lobby_member_limit
method.description: Returns the maximum number of members of the lobby [param lobby_id], or [code]0[/code] if unknown.

method.name: get_lobby_members
method.description: Returns the Steam IDs of the members of the lobby [param lobby_id]. Only works for lobbies the local user is a member of.

method.name: get_lobby_owner
method.description: Returns the Steam ID of the owner of the lobby [param lobby_id], or [code]0[/code] if unknown. Only works for lobbies the local user is a member of.

method.name: get_local_steam_id
method.description: Returns the local user's 64-bit Steam ID, or [code]0[/code] if unavailable.

method.name: get_num_lobby_members
method.description: Returns the number of members in the lobby [param lobby_id]. Only works for lobbies the local user is a member of.

method.name: get_num_subscribed_items
method.description: Returns the number of Workshop items the local user is subscribed to for this app. If [param include_locally_disabled] is [code]true[/code], items the user disabled locally are counted too.

method.name: get_pending_auth_ticket_handle
method.description: Returns the auth ticket handle from the last ticket request.

method.name: get_pending_hex_ticket
method.description: Returns the hex-encoded ticket from the last successful ticket request.

method.name: get_pending_ticket_error
method.description: Returns the error message from the last failed ticket request.

method.name: get_persona_name
method.description: Returns the local user's Steam persona (display) name.

method.name: get_stat_float
method.description: Returns the current float stat value, or [code]0.0[/code] if unavailable.

method.name: get_stat_int
method.description: Returns the current integer stat value, or [code]-1[/code] if unavailable.

method.name: get_subscribed_items
method.description: Returns the published file IDs of all Workshop items the local user is subscribed to for this app. If [param include_locally_disabled] is [code]true[/code], items the user disabled locally are included.

method.name: get_ticket_state
method.description: Returns the current ticket request state.

method.name: get_workshop_consumer_app_id
method.description: Returns the app ID whose Workshop items are made, updated and listed: the one set with [method set_workshop_app_ids], or the running app's ID.

method.name: get_workshop_creator_app_id
method.description: Returns the app ID that Workshop queries expect items to have been made with: the one set with [method set_workshop_app_ids], or the consumer app ID.

method.name: has_leaderboard_support
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the loaded Steam API library exposes the leaderboard functions.

method.name: has_matchmaking_support
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the loaded Steam API library exposes [code]ISteamMatchmaking[/code] (lobbies).

method.name: has_networking_support
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the loaded Steam API library exposes [code]ISteamNetworkingSockets[/code], which [SteamMultiplayerPeer] requires.

method.name: has_workshop_support
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the loaded Steam API library exposes the Steam Workshop ([code]ISteamUGC[/code]) interface. Requires Steamworks SDK 1.60 or newer.

method.name: increment_stat_int
method.description: Increments an integer stat in memory by [code]1[/code]. [param delta] must be [code]1[/code]. Call [method store_stats] to persist.

method.name: init_relay_network_access
method.description: Starts connecting to the Steam Datagram Relay network. [SteamMultiplayerPeer] calls this automatically, but calling it right after [method initialize] makes the first connection faster. Does nothing if it was already called.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Loads and initializes the Steam API. [param app_id] sets [code]SteamAppId[/code] when greater than zero.

method.name: invite_user_to_lobby
method.description: Sends a Steam invite for the lobby [param lobby_id] to the user [param steam_id]. The user receives [signal lobby_invite_received] if the game is running, or a Steam chat invite otherwise.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the Steam API library was found and loaded.

method.name: is_debug_logging_enabled
method.description: Returns whether debug logging is enabled.

method.name: is_initialized
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] after a successful [method initialize] call.

method.name: is_logged_on
method.description: Returns whether the local Steam user is logged on.

method.name: join_lobby
method.description: Asks to join the lobby [param lobby_id]. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request couldn't be sent. The result arrives through [signal lobby_joined].

method.name: leave_lobby
method.description: Leaves the lobby [param lobby_id]. Other members receive [signal lobby_member_state_changed] with [constant LOBBY_MEMBER_LEFT]. If the owner leaves, Steam picks a new owner.

method.name: poll_callbacks
method.description: Pumps the Steam manual callback dispatch queue.

method.name: query_user_workshop_items
method.description: Sends a query for Workshop items in one of a user's lists (published, subscribed, favorited, ...). [param steam_id] defaults to the local user. Accepts the same [param options] as [method query_workshop_items], except [code]cursor[/code]. Emits [signal workshop_query_completed]. Returns the query handle, or [code]-1[/code] on failure.

method.name: query_workshop_item_details
method.description: Sends a query for the details of specific Workshop items. Accepts the same [param options] as [method query_workshop_items], except [code]cursor[/code]. Emits [signal workshop_query_completed]. Returns the query handle, or [code]-1[/code] on failure.

method.name: query_workshop_items
method.description: Sends a query for all Workshop items of this app, ranked by [param query_type] and filtered by [param matching_type]. Results are paged ([code]50[/code] per page, starting at [code]1[/code]). Emits [signal workshop_query_completed] with the returned [SteamWorkshopItem]s. Returns the query handle, or [code]-1[/code] on failure. Supported [param options] keys: - [code]required_tags[/code] / [code]excluded_tags[/code] ([PackedStringArray]) and [code]match_any_tag[/code] ([bool]). - [code]required_key_value_tags[/code] ([Dictionary] of [String] to [String]). - [code]search_text[/code] ([String]), [code]ranked_by_trend_days[/code] ([int]), [code]language[/code] ([String], an API language code such as [code]"english"[/code]), [code]cloud_file_name_filter[/code] ([String]). - [code]allow_cached_response[/code] ([int], max age in seconds). - [code]return_long_description[/code], [code]return_metadata[/code], [code]return_key_value_tags[/code], [code]return_children[/code], [code]return_additional_previews[/code], [code]return_only_ids[/code], [code]return_total_only[/code] ([bool]). - [code]cursor[/code] ([String]): use cursor paging instead of [param page]. Pass [code]"*"[/code] for the first page, then the [code]next_cursor[/code] from [signal workshop_query_completed].

method.name: refresh_current_stats
method.description: Waits for a fresh user-stats callback from Steam, for example after server-side achievement changes. Uses cached data if no callback arrives in time.

method.name: remove_all_item_key_value_tags
method.description: Removes all existing key-value tags from the item in an update.

method.name: remove_item_from_favorites
method.description: Removes a Workshop item from the local user's favorites. Emits [signal workshop_favorites_changed].

method.name: remove_item_key_value_tags
method.description: Removes all key-value tags with the given key from the item in an update.

method.name: remove_item_preview
method.description: Removes an additional preview, by index, from the item in an update.

method.name: request_current_stats
method.description: Ensures local achievement and stat data is loaded. Returns immediately when stats are already available.

method.name: request_lobby_list
method.description: Searches for [constant LOBBY_TYPE_PUBLIC] lobbies of this game, using the filters added since the previous search. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request couldn't be sent. The results arrive through [signal lobby_list_received]; their lobby data can be read with [method get_lobby_data] right away. [codeblock] Steam.add_lobby_list_string_filter("mode", "race") Steam.add_lobby_list_slots_available_filter(1) Steam.lobby_list_received.connect(_on_lobby_list_received, CONNECT_ONE_SHOT) Steam.request_lobby_list() [/codeblock]

method.name: request_web_api_ticket
method.description: Requests a Web API session ticket and emits [signal web_api_ticket_ready] on success.

method.name: set_achievement
method.description: Unlocks an achievement for the local user in memory. Call [method store_stats] to persist.

method.name: set_debug_logging
method.description: Enables or disables verbose debug logging.

method.name: set_item_content
method.description: Sets the folder whose contents are uploaded as the item's content in an update. [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] paths are converted to absolute paths.

method.name: set_item_description
method.description: Sets the description of the item in an update started with [method start_item_update] (max 8000 characters).

method.name: set_item_metadata
method.description: Sets developer metadata for the item in an update. This is arbitrary text not shown to users, retrieved with [code]return_metadata[/code] in queries (max 10000 bytes on SDK 1.62+, 5000 before).

method.name: set_item_preview
method.description: Sets the main preview image of the item in an update. [code]res://[/code] and [code]user://[/code] paths are converted to absolute paths. The file should be under 1 MB.

method.name: set_item_tags
method.description: Replaces the tags of the item in an update. Tags must be defined in the app's Workshop configuration on Steamworks. If [param allow_admin_tags] is [code]true[/code], admin-only tags may be set.

method.name: set_item_title
method.description: Sets the title of the item in an update started with [method start_item_update] (max 128 characters).

method.name: set_item_update_language
method.description: Sets the language (API language code, such as [code]"english"[/code]) of the title and description set in this update.

method.name: set_item_visibility
method.description: Sets the visibility of the item in an update.

method.name: set_lobby_data
method.description: Sets the lobby data [param key] to [param value] for the lobby [param lobby_id]. Lobby data is visible to everyone, including players searching with [method request_lobby_list]. Only the owner can do this. Members receive [signal lobby_data_updated].

method.name: set_lobby_joinable
method.description: Sets whether new players can join the lobby [param lobby_id]. For example, disable it once the match starts. Only the owner can do this.

method.name: set_lobby_member_data
method.description: Sets data for the local user in the lobby [param lobby_id], visible to the other members (for example a selected character or a ready flag). Members receive [signal lobby_data_updated].

method.name: set_lobby_member_limit
method.description: Changes the maximum number of members of the lobby [param lobby_id]. Only the owner can do this.

method.name: set_lobby_owner
method.description: Makes [param steam_id] the owner of the lobby [param lobby_id]. Only the current owner can do this.

method.name: set_lobby_type
method.description: Changes the type (visibility) of the lobby [param lobby_id]. Only the owner can do this.

method.name: set_stat_float
method.description: Sets a float stat to an absolute value in memory. Call [method store_stats] to persist.

method.name: set_stat_int
method.description: Sets an integer stat to an absolute value in memory. Call [method store_stats] to persist.

method.name: set_user_item_vote
method.description: Votes a Workshop item up ([code]true[/code]) or down ([code]false[/code]). Emits [signal workshop_item_vote_set].

method.name: set_workshop_app_ids
method.description: Sets which apps the Workshop calls use, for a creation tool that has its own app ID and publishes into a game's Workshop. [param consumer_app_id] is the game: [method create_workshop_item], [method start_item_update] and the favorites calls use it, and the queries list its items. [param creator_app_id] is the app the items were made with; [method query_workshop_items] and [method query_user_workshop_items] pass it to Steam. Pass [code]0[/code] for either to use the running app (the default). One of the two must be the running app, and the tool's app ID must be listed under App Publish Permissions on the game's Workshop configuration page. [codeblock] # In the creation tool (its own app ID): Steam.initialize(TOOL_APP_ID) Steam.set_workshop_app_ids(GAME_APP_ID, TOOL_APP_ID) # In the game, to list items made with the tool: Steam.set_workshop_app_ids(GAME_APP_ID, TOOL_APP_ID) [/codeblock]

method.name: show_lobby_invite_dialog
method.description: Opens the Steam overlay dialog for inviting friends to the lobby [param lobby_id].

method.name: show_workshop_eula
method.description: Opens the Steam overlay showing the app's Workshop EULA. Returns [code]false[/code] if the overlay could not be opened.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Shuts down the Steam API session.

method.name: start_item_update
method.description: Starts an update of a Workshop item owned by the local user and returns an update handle, or [code]-1[/code] on failure. Set the changed properties with the [code]set_item_*[/code], [code]add_item_*[/code] and [code]remove_item_*[/code] methods, then call [method submit_item_update].

method.name: start_playtime_tracking
method.description: Starts tracking playtime for the given Workshop items, for example the mods loaded for the current session. Emits [signal workshop_playtime_tracking_updated].

method.name: stop_playtime_tracking
method.description: Stops tracking playtime for the given Workshop items. Emits [signal workshop_playtime_tracking_updated].

method.name: stop_playtime_tracking_for_all_items
method.description: Stops tracking playtime for all Workshop items. Emits [signal workshop_playtime_tracking_updated].

method.name: store_stats
method.description: Uploads pending achievement and stat changes to Steam.

method.name: submit_item_update
method.description: Submits an update started with [method start_item_update], with an optional [param change_note] shown on the item's change log. Emits [signal workshop_item_updated] when the upload finishes. Use [method get_item_update_progress] to track progress. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request could not be sent.

method.name: subscribe_item
method.description: Subscribes the local user to a Workshop item. The item is downloaded and installed as soon as possible. Emits [signal workshop_item_subscribed] when Steam responds. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request could not be sent.

method.name: suspend_downloads
method.description: Suspends ([code]true[/code]) or resumes ([code]false[/code]) Workshop downloads, for example during gameplay. Downloads resume automatically when the game quits.

method.name: trigger_item_drop
method.description: Triggers a playtime item drop for a [code]playtimegenerator[/code] item definition. Waits for the async inventory result.

method.name: unsubscribe_item
method.description: Unsubscribes the local user from a Workshop item. The item is removed after the game quits. Emits [signal workshop_item_unsubscribed] when Steam responds. Returns [code]false[/code] if the request could not be sent.

method.name: upload_leaderboard_score
method.description: Uploads a score for the local user to the leaderboard [param handle] and blocks until Steam answers (up to 10 seconds). If [param keep_best] is [code]true[/code], Steam keeps the user's previous score when it's better; otherwise the score is always replaced. [param details] can hold up to 64 extra integers (for example split times), returned with [method download_leaderboard_entries]. Returns a [Dictionary] with the keys [code]success[/code] ([bool]), [code]score_changed[/code] ([bool]), [code]global_rank_new[/code] ([int]) and [code]global_rank_previous[/code] ([int], [code]0[/code] if the user had no entry). [b]Note:[/b] Steam rate-limits uploads to about 10 per 10 minutes per leaderboard.

signal.name: lobby_created
signal.description: Emitted when a [method create_lobby] request finishes. [param result] is a Steam [code]EResult[/code] value: [code]1[/code] on success; [code]15[/code] means Steam couldn't be reached. [param lobby_id] is [code]0[/code] on failure.

signal.name: lobby_data_updated
signal.description: Emitted when lobby data changes in a lobby the local user is in, or when the data of a listed lobby arrives. [param member_steam_id] is the member whose data changed, or equal to [param lobby_id] when the lobby data itself changed.

signal.name: lobby_invite_received
signal.description: Emitted when a friend invites the local user to a lobby while the game is running.

signal.name: lobby_join_requested
signal.description: Emitted when the local user accepts a lobby invite, or chooses "Join game" on a friend, from the Steam overlay or friends list while the game is running. Call [method join_lobby] with [param lobby_id] to join.

signal.name: lobby_joined
signal.description: Emitted when the local user enters a lobby, either through [method join_lobby] or after a successful [method create_lobby]. The join succeeded if [param response] is [constant LOBBY_ENTER_SUCCESS].

signal.name: lobby_kicked
signal.description: Emitted when the local user was removed from the lobby [param lobby_id].

signal.name: lobby_list_received
signal.description: Emitted when a [method request_lobby_list] search finishes. [param lobby_ids] is empty when nothing matched or Steam couldn't be reached.

signal.name: lobby_member_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the user [param steam_id] enters or leaves a lobby the local user is in. [param changed_by_steam_id] is the user who caused the change, which differs from [param steam_id] when someone was kicked or banned.

signal.name: web_api_ticket_failed
signal.description: Emitted when [method request_web_api_ticket] fails.

signal.name: web_api_ticket_ready
signal.description: Emitted when a Web API session ticket is ready.

signal.name: workshop_favorites_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method add_item_to_favorites] or [method remove_item_from_favorites] completes.

signal.name: workshop_item_created
signal.description: Emitted when [method create_workshop_item] completes. If [param needs_to_accept_agreement] is [code]true[/code], the user must accept the Steam Workshop legal agreement before the item becomes visible; consider opening the item's page in the overlay.

signal.name: workshop_item_deleted
signal.description: Emitted when [method delete_workshop_item] completes.

signal.name: workshop_item_downloaded
signal.description: Emitted when a Workshop item download, for example one started with [method download_item], finishes.

signal.name: workshop_item_installed
signal.description: Emitted when a Workshop item for this app has been installed or updated, whether or not the game requested it. Use [method get_item_install_info] to locate its content.

signal.name: workshop_item_subscribed
signal.description: Emitted when [method subscribe_item] completes.

signal.name: workshop_item_unsubscribed
signal.description: Emitted when [method unsubscribe_item] completes.

signal.name: workshop_item_updated
signal.description: Emitted when [method submit_item_update] completes. If [param needs_to_accept_agreement] is [code]true[/code], the user must accept the Steam Workshop legal agreement before the item becomes visible.

signal.name: workshop_item_vote_set
signal.description: Emitted when [method set_user_item_vote] completes.

signal.name: workshop_playtime_tracking_updated
signal.description: Emitted when a playtime tracking request completes. [param started] is [code]true[/code] for [method start_playtime_tracking] and [code]false[/code] for the stop methods.

signal.name: workshop_query_completed
signal.description: Emitted when a query sent by [method query_workshop_items], [method query_user_workshop_items] or [method query_workshop_item_details] completes. [param items] contains [SteamWorkshopItem]s and is empty on failure. [param result] is a Steam [code]EResult[/code] code ([code]1[/code] means success). [param next_cursor] is set for cursor-based queries.

signal.name: workshop_subscriptions_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the local user's list of subscribed Workshop items for this app changes.
